Use ONLY its FIRST card, December21 at4:32AM Bored. Restore that missing tag from original, translated「学校」. Image3 original bored-face crop preserves original art; remove only its dark background. Image4 approved Lighthouse bus is STYLE ONLY for white rounded surface, subtle neutral border and soft downward shadow.
Create one compact white rounded card on pure white canvas, logical390x205 proportion. Left-aligned date/time, then one row of small original yellow bored emoji (small oval eyes, flat horizontal mouth) and mood label, then the exact one-line journal sentence, then three outlined white pill tags in one row. Keep all controls and text readable with no clipping. No other entries, page header, navigation, buttons or extra text.

「12月21日 午前4:32」
「退屈」

Artwork: preserve ORIGINAL bored face shape and optical scale, no generic substitute, no dark square crop background. Original card's purple differentiates this mood group; adapt that evidence to a restrained very pale muted-purple circular backing BEHIND THE SMALL EMOJI ONLY, not the entire card. Purple is a coherent mood-category accent here, not a form-icon palette. All3 activity tags white with fine neutral outlines and dark regular text; no random separate tag colors or mint fills.
Use subtle neutral card outline, quiet24px corner radius, soft downward shadow. White surfaces, compact consistent spacing, aligned baselines, gentle separation. No broad tint, decorative gradient, gloss/glow, invented primary action, metric or device frame. Static raster candidate only.
